justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Systematic reviews consistently show minimal benefit over sham taping; any pain effect is small and short-term.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 2-day KT1/KT2 courses; ~$400-600 total; widely available; one of the most accessible certs.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable across outpatient ortho, sports, and neuro caseloads; taping applicable to a wide range of conditions.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Tape application billed under procedure codes; standard PT coverage; no CKTP billing premium over standard therapeutic procedure.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Widely held and moderately demanded; taping certification commonly listed as preferred in sports and outpatient roles.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients like the colorful tape and perceive it as active treatment; expectation effects likely.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Consumers will pay small add-on fees for tape, but it doesn't anchor a cash-pay practice.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Highly commoditized — nearly every athletic trainer and many PTs are familiar with taping.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Saturated; CKTP letters add little defensibility.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Easy to train staff and integrate as an upsell across a practice.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Strong consumer recognition thanks to Olympic exposure.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Commercial brand credential with negligible academic standing.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Modest publication base, largely small studies and reviews.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Marginal — covered briefly in modalities or sports content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Systematic reviews consistently show small to negligible clinical effects.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Never required or preferred for faculty roles.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Cheap and quick but with minimal academic payoff.
